cards.subject: Kalidar
lines: It was called Kalidar on the preview site, the concept maps and the printed DVD.
The name was never fully removed — most of the objects you are walking over are still labelled with it in the files.

cards.subject: The tree nobody blessed
lines: Fandral grew it from Nordrassil's line to win back the immortality the night elves spent at Hyjal.
Nozdormu refused to bless it as he had blessed the first one.
The immortality never came. You are walking through a failed copy of a holy thing.

cards.subject: The tree you cannot see
lines: Metzen wanted the whole World Tree visible from the zone and the terrain engine could not do it.
What shipped is a flat playfield on a huge pillar with branches stuck out of the sides. You are not in a canopy, you are on a lid.
Aldrassil, the tree at Shadowglen, is the stand-in for the enormous one you are supposed to be inside.

cards.subject: There is nothing under it
lines: Not poor ore. None. There is nowhere in this zone a miner can work.
You are standing on wood, above an island, above the sea.
Herbs, on the other hand, are everywhere, because the whole zone is alive.

cards.subject: The rivers are dew
lines: Every waterway here was made by, and is still fed by, dew the World Tree collects.
The tree condenses its own weather and the runoff becomes rivers.
The largest lake on it is a puddle on a leaf.

cards.subject: The Oracle Tree
lines: Its boughs are grown into the shape of a great eagle perched on top of a bear.
It was not carved. It was grown that way.
The moonwell beside it is the first and most powerful on the tree — the oldest thing up here.

cards.subject: Nobody knows why
cards.tag: The investigation the game never closes
lines: Furbolgs and grell go mad, satyrs appear, and the druids looking into it never find the cause.
Two of them are running an open investigation you can join and cannot finish.
The only physical evidence anybody has is fel moss on the bodies.

cards.subject: The turtles left
cards.tag: You can see it from the next zone
lines: As the corruption spread, the giant turtles and threshers in the waters around the tree abandoned them.
They swam to Darkshore and beached themselves rather than stay.
The animals in the sea worked it out before the druids in the tree did.

cards.subject: Timberlings
lines: The shoreline is full of walking saplings grown from seeds off the trees above them.
There is a tent by the water where somebody is collecting the seeds, trying to work out what changed.
This is not something attacking the tree from outside. The tree's own children are what is coming at you.

cards.subject: Ferocitas the Dream Eater
cards.tag: The name is the only clue
lines: The Gnarlpine have two named leaders. One is called the Mauler. The other is called the Dream Eater.
Nothing else in the zone points at the Emerald Dream, and this is a mob's name rather than a piece of evidence.
The furbolgs took the barrow den, which is where the dreaming bodies are.

cards.subject: Ban'ethil Barrow Den
lines: It was built as a sacred place to hold druids in hibernation.
The Gnarlpine hold it now, which makes it lethal ground for a night elf on their own.
This is not a dungeon. It is a bedroom, and somebody else is in it.

cards.subject: Oben Rageclaw
lines: A sleeping druid speaks to you as a ghost, next to his own body.
The body is being puppeted by the shaman occupying the den.
He asks you to destroy it. His spirit is stranded in the Dream and cannot rest until you do.

cards.subject: The battleground called Kalidar
lines: A complete battleground map under the zone's old name sits in the unused files, its satellite imagery intact.
It never shipped, was never named in-game, and nobody ever queued for it.
